page.title: Automation
page.description: Scheduled messages and safe chat commands, sent through the same connected account and outbound dispatcher as manual Chat page sending.

common.unresolvedWarning: Unresolved: {{names}} - this send will be skipped rather than sending malformed text.
common.tooLongWarning: The rendered message exceeds this application's own 500-character limit.
common.noAccounts: No Twitch or YouTube account is ready to send outbound chat yet.
common.permissionRequiredHint: This account needs the outbound-chat permission upgrade first - see the Chat page's composer.
common.restartNotice: No backlog is replayed after a backend restart: offline or skipped messages are never sent later, and every enabled schedule gets a fresh countdown. Activity counts reset after each successful scheduled send. Local and platform rate limits still apply on top of this schedule's own settings.

schedules.empty: No scheduled messages yet. Create one to have Streaming Tree post on a timer.
schedules.deleteConfirmMessage: "{{name}}" will stop sending immediately. This cannot be undone.
schedules.sendNowMessage: This sends a real message immediately to the eligible targets below, bypassing the interval, first delay and minimum-activity checks. Local and platform rate limits, message length and account permission still apply.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: For your own reference only - never sent to chat.
fields.enabledHint: A disabled schedule never sends, but keeps its configuration.
fields.firstDelayHint: Delay before the very first send after creating or editing this schedule. 0 uses a safe 5-second floor - it never sends the instant the backend restarts.
fields.jitterHint: An extra 0 to this many seconds is added after each interval, so sends never land at a perfectly predictable moment. Never earlier than the configured interval.
fields.onlyWhileReceiving: Only send while OBS is streaming
fields.onlyWhileReceivingHint: Local Streaming Tree ingest only - not Twitch's own "live" status, not viewer count. A due send while offline is skipped, not queued for later.
fields.minimumChatMessages: Minimum chat messages since last send
fields.minimumChatMessagesHint: Real human messages only - your own sent messages, test events and bot-marked users never count.
fields.maximumSendsPerHourHint: A rolling limit on this schedule's own successful sends - separate from (and in addition to) the platform's own rate limits.
fields.messagesHint: At least one. When there is more than one, a random alternative is chosen each time, avoiding an immediate repeat.

commands.empty: No chat commands yet. Create one to let viewers trigger a safe response.
commands.deleteConfirmMessage: "!{{name}}" and its aliases will stop responding immediately. This cannot be undone.

fields.name: Command name
fields.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, "_" and "-" only - shown to viewers with a leading "!".
fields.globalCooldownHint: 0 to 3600 seconds. Applies across every user.

commands.prefixNotice: Commands always use the fixed "!" prefix - it is not configurable in this stage.

errors.chat_automation_account_not_found: That connected account no longer exists.
errors.chat_automation_target_required: At least one target account is required.
errors.chat_automation_target_invalid: That destination does not belong to the selected account.
errors.chat_automation_command_conflict: That command name or alias is already in use.
errors.chat_automation_placeholder_invalid: The template uses an unknown or malformed placeholder.
errors.chat_automation_provider_unsupported: This account's provider does not support outbound chat.
errors.chat_automation_permission_required: This account needs the outbound-chat permission upgrade first.
errors.chat_automation_queue_full: Too many automated messages are already queued for this account.
errors.account_reconnect_required: This account must be reconnected first.
